cases.label: DISPATCHES Wind-Battery-PEM
cases.request: Build a DISPATCHES hybrid-energy system that splits wind generation among the grid, battery storage, and PEM electrolysis. Store the hydrogen and route it to both a hydrogen turbine and a pipeline product.

cases.label: WaterTAP UConn WRRF
cases.request: Build the WaterTAP UConn water resource recovery facility with its five-reactor activated-sludge train, two mixing points, secondary separation, treated-effluent outlet, and both internal recycle loops.

cases.label: PrOMMiS CMI Process PFD
cases.request: Reconstruct the PrOMMiS rare-earth magnet recycling process shown in the supplied PFD. Preserve dissolution, adjustment, precipitation, both separation steps, calcination, waste streams, and the rare-earth-oxide product.

cases.label: PrOMMiS Multicomponent Ion Exchange
cases.request: Build a PrOMMiS multicomponent ion-exchange treatment process for an aqueous rare-earth solution, with feed conditioning, a Freundlich ion-exchange unit, and a treated product stream.

cases.label: DISPATCHES Nuclear Multiperiod
cases.request: Build the multiperiod DISPATCHES nuclear-hydrogen system with nuclear generation, electricity allocation between the grid and PEM electrolysis, hydrogen storage and sales, inter-period state links, and market-price dispatch.

cases.label: WaterTAP Seawater RO PAT
cases.request: Build the full WaterTAP seawater reverse-osmosis desalination train with chemical pretreatment, media and cartridge filtration, pump-as-turbine energy recovery, RO separation, posttreatment, municipal-water storage, landfill handling, and brine disposal.

cases.label: DISPATCHES Simple Rankine Cycle
cases.request: Build initialize and solve the DISPATCHES simple Rankine cycle with boiler turbine condenser pump and recycle and evaluate its design objective.

cases.label: PrOMMiS CMI Process
cases.request: Build a PrOMMiS rare-earth magnet recycling process with dissolution, solution adjustment, precipitation, solid-liquid separation, calcination, waste handling, and a rare-earth-oxide product.

cases.label: Bsm2
cases.request: Build the full WaterTAP BSM2 wastewater-treatment plant with activated-sludge reactors, clarifiers, recycle and sludge-handling loops, anaerobic digestion, dewatering, treated-water production, and waste sludge.

cases.label: DISPATCHES Solar-Battery-Hydrogen
cases.request: Build the DISPATCHES solar hybrid system that allocates photovoltaic power among grid delivery, battery storage, and PEM electrolysis, then stores hydrogen for pipeline sales or turbine generation.

cases.label: WaterTAP Seawater RO
cases.request: Build the full WaterTAP seawater reverse-osmosis desalination train with chemical pretreatment, media and cartridge filtration, pressure-exchanger energy recovery, RO separation, posttreatment, municipal-water storage, landfill handling, and brine disposal.

cases.label: PrOMMiS Leach Flowsheet
cases.request: Build a PrOMMiS leaching flowsheet that combines liquid and solid feeds in the leach section and produces separate pregnant-liquid and residual-solid streams.

cases.label: Reaktoro-PSE Simple Ion Exchange
cases.request: Build and solve the Reaktoro-PSE ion-exchange equilibrium example and report calcium magnesium pH and base-addition results.

cases.label: Nf Dspmde Base
cases.request: Build the base WaterTAP DSPM-DE nanofiltration flowsheet with feed conditioning and pumping, one NF unit, a treated product, and a separate retentate disposal stream.

cases.label: WaterTAP Multi-Stage OARO
cases.request: Build the official configurable multi-stage WaterTAP OARO system with interstage pumps energy recovery final RO and product and disposal streams.

cases.label: Plate Heat Exchanger
cases.request: Build an IDAES plate heat exchanger with separate hot and cold feeds and corresponding hot and cold product streams.

cases.label: Nf Dspmde With Bypass
cases.request: Build a WaterTAP DSPM-DE nanofiltration flowsheet with an explicit bypass. Split the groundwater feed before the NF branch and recombine the bypass with the NF product while keeping the retentate disposal stream separate.

cases.label: IDAES Supercritical Steam Cycle
cases.request: Build the official IDAES supercritical pulverized-coal steam cycle with the turbine train, reheating, condenser, condensate and boiler-feed pumps, and feedwater-heater train.

cases.label: Supercritical Power Plant
cases.request: Build the complete IDAES supercritical coal-fired power plant with economizer, waterwall and superheater sections, attemperation, reheating, steam turbines, condenser, hotwell, feedwater heaters, boiler-feed pumps, and power generation.

cases.label: NGFC ATR
cases.request: Build the NGFC autothermal-reformer subsystem with staged air compression and intercooling, natural-gas expansion, recuperative heating, feed and bypass mixing, autothermal reforming, and the downstream bypass rejoin. Include the steady-state design optimization.

cases.label: PrOMMiS Superstructure NPV
cases.request: Build a PrOMMiS process-pathway superstructure with alternative units at the second and third stages. Select a feasible route from feed availability to the final pathway and evaluate its net present value.

cases.label: WaterTAP BSM2 ElectroNP no bioP
cases.request: Build a WaterTAP BSM2 wastewater-treatment flowsheet with activated-sludge reactors, clarification, sludge recycle, anaerobic digestion, and ElectroNP phosphorus recovery. Use the configuration without biological phosphorus removal.
